items.name: x-button
items.title: XButton
items.description: `<x-button>` — an action element backed by a real native `<button>` inside the shadow root, so focus, keyboard activation and accessibility come from the platform. Note: `type="submit"` does not submit an outer form (Shadow DOM limitation).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the native button and blocks `x-button-click`.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Marks the button busy with `aria-busy="true"` and blocks clicks.

events.name: x-button-click
events.description: Fired when the user activates the button; `detail.originalEvent` is the native MouseEvent.

slots.description: Default slot: the button label (text, icon, or both).

cssProperties.name: --x-button-height
cssProperties.description: Control height; defaults to 2.25rem (2rem sm, 2.75rem lg).

cssProperties.name: --x-button-radius
cssProperties.description: Corner radius; defaults to 0.5rem (0.375rem sm, 0.625rem lg).

cssProperties.name: --x-button-font-size
cssProperties.description: Label font size; defaults to 0.875rem (0.8125rem sm, 1rem lg).
